incidents.classification: setup interruption; excluded from performance results
details: Model loaded successfully, but the execution sandbox denied localhost requests with WinError 10013. The interrupted harness did not record inference results.
psutil.swap_memory raised RuntimeError because PdhAddEnglishCounterW was unavailable. This optional query was removed. RAM, process RSS and nvidia-smi monitoring continued in subsequent runs.

incidents.classification: pinned-host loading / CUDA allocation failures; retained
details: The first 2 GiB cache reached warm-up and failed while creating a cuBLAS handle. The retry and 3 GiB variants failed CUDA cache allocation during initialization.
Available RAM and sampled GPU memory are retained in resource-samples.json. The evidence does not isolate a physical VRAM limit or root cause.
Memory-mapped loading succeeded with both 3 GiB and 4 GiB caches. All held-out configurations use this loading mode.
